messages:
marie (PM): Quick sync — we need a concrete MVP for parallel + multi-step tool calling. Customer asks coming from two customers: a marketplace integrator and an automation vendor. They want up to ~3 external calls in one turn, control over ordering, per-call timeouts, and predictable cost.

ash (Eng): TL;DR: implement 'parallelCalls' array + per-item timeout/retry fields, and a simple ordering hint. Keep runtime changes minimal.

ravi (Eng-runtime): Can we do this without a full DAG execution engine? Prefer best-effort parallelism + causal ordering flag. For retries we need idempotency keys on external actions.

sam (Solutions): Customer use-case: call CRM, enrichment service, and payment provider in same flow. They need partial responses if one call times out, not whole request failure.

marie (PM): Proposed MVP scope (idea):
- API: support `parallel_calls` in the chat message schema (array up to 4).
- Each call: `{id, target, input, timeout_ms, retry_policy, ordering_hint}`.
- Runtime: fire all calls concurrently, collect responses, apply `ordering_hint` if present to stitch outputs. If a call times out, return partial result + call status.
- Retries: client-provided `idempotency_key` required for any retryable action.
- Default: max 2 automatic retries with exponential backoff, configurable.

ash (Eng): Implementation notes: keep current inference loop unchanged. Spawn non-blocking HTTP tasks for each external call. Use existing batching for model tokens, and attach call futures to response assembly. Minimal kernel/runtime changes.

ravi (Eng-runtime): Danger: uncontrolled parallel external calls can blow up CPU/IO. Need quotas per-request and per-api-key. Also add a per-call cost estimate in console to prevent surprise billing.

marie (PM): Launch criteria suggestion:
- Functional: support N=3 parallel calls, per-call timeout + per-call retry, partial-response semantics documented.
- Reliability: p99 end-to-end latency meeting SLA for typical 1 external call; for 3 calls, document multi-call tail behavior.
- Security: require idempotency and auth propagation rules for private connectors.
- Observability: per-call metrics in Console (latency, errors, retries, timeouts).
- Docs + SDK: examples in JS/Python + migration guide.

sam (Solutions): Add customer validation: partner will run a pilot with 2 integrations and send failure scenarios. We should include a checklist for them.

ash (Eng): API sketch (pseudo):
```
{
  "parallel_calls": [
    {"id":"c1","target":"crm.create","input":{...},"timeout_ms":1500,"retry_policy":"exp_backoff","ordering_hint":1},
    {"id":"c2","target":"enrich","input":{...},"timeout_ms":500,"retry_policy":"none","ordering_hint":2}
  ],
  "fallback_model":"gpt-lite"
}
```

ravi (Eng-runtime): Also include `call_status` in model-visible output so prompts can condition on failures. E.g. `{calls:[{id:'c1',status:'ok',resp:...},{id:'c2',status:'timeout'}]}`. This keeps structured output parity.

marie (PM): Prioritization: rank this as P1 for next quarter for hosted API customers in marketplace verticals. Tradeoffs: no full orchestration (no loop-within-tool) in MVP. If we need more complex control, that will be Phase 2.

ash (Eng): Engineering estimate: core runtime + API + SDK examples = 4-6 sprints across eng + infra + SDK. Phase gating: first internal alpha, then partner pilot.

ravi (Eng-runtime): Ops ask: add quotas + circuit-breaker for callers hitting >X parallel calls per minute, and a flag to route heavy flows to Dedicated customers.

marie (PM): KPIs to track post-launch: adoption (pilot -> GA conversion), average per-request cost delta, p95/p99 latency delta for multi-call flows, partial-response rate, and customer satisfaction from pilot.

slo-bot: New SLO created: "parallel-calls.end-to-end.p99" baseline=1200ms for single external call path, documented degradation for multi-call.

sam (Solutions): I'll draft a partner pilot plan and failure scenario suite. @ravi @ash please review API sketch and idempotency requirements.

ravi (Eng-runtime): I'll validate runtime limits and propose safe defaults for quotas.

ash (Eng): I'll sketch SDK helpers for client-side `idempotency_key` management and example error handling.

marie (PM): Great — meeting next Tuesday to lock MVP API shape. If anyone has strong objections to the per-call retry defaults or ordering semantics, raise them before EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
